notes.zh: App 入口与网页版分离，移除诊断中切回旧内置页面的按钮，修复启动生命周期事件与诊断日志阻塞；复用高斯排序缓冲区。每次更新同时提供完整新版 APK 和签名热更新包。原生诊断与入口修复请覆盖安装本版 APK，项目保留。
notes.en: Separate App navigation from the browser hub, remove bundled-page downgrade recovery, guard startup lifecycle events and move diagnostic writes off the UI thread. Recycle Gaussian sort buffers. Every update includes a full current APK and a signed web update. Install this APK for the native fixes; projects are retained.
